description.value: PappaRoti Keefer Place is a Malaysian café chain location operating since 2017 in the heart of Vancouver's Chinatown, serving freshly baked coffee-caramel roti buns made every 30 minutes, straight from the oven. It is the brand's second BC location and also offers organic teas, coffees, sandwiches, salads, and ice cream buns unique to this outpost. The café sits within one of the largest and most historically significant Chinatowns in North America, making it a culturally notable stop for cyclists passing through the area.
